LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is reading a text fluently important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read a text at the right speed, accurately and with expression for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 6.2.1 READING FLUENCY
This lesson teaches Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. read a text at the right speed, accurately and with expression for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency above.
2. Explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is reading a text fluently important?
2. How can one read a text fluently?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read a text at the right speed, accurately and with expression for effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
